remaining_fraction.direction: 1.0 is full quota available; 0.0 is completely exhausted
remaining_fraction.epistemic_rule: Null if limit or remaining is unknown; NEVER assumed to be 1.0

used_fraction.epistemic_rule: Null if used or limit is unknown

quota_pressure.direction: 1.0 is maximum exhaustion pressure; 0.0 is zero pressure

time_until_reset_ms.direction: Lower values mean reset is closer in time
time_until_reset_ms.epistemic_rule: Null if reset_at is not documented/observed

expiry_fraction.direction: 0.0 is expiring immediately; 1.0 is just started
expiry_fraction.epistemic_rule: Derived only when both reset_at and window_duration are known

reset_urgency.direction: 1.0 is highest urgency (expiring right now); 0.0 is lowest urgency
reset_urgency.epistemic_rule: 0.0 if time until reset is unknown

rules.mismatch_action: REJECT with SCOPE_MISMATCH; do not constrain other models
Matches all lanes belonging to record.provider_id

rules.matches_lane: Matches all lanes on the account

binding_window_rule.description: When multiple scoped windows match a lane, the binding window is the one with min(remaining_fraction), or if tied, min(window_duration_ms). Any window with limitReached=true or remaining_fraction <= 0 immediately blocks the lane.
